use_case_name: Define Reference Points and Geometric Areas

evidence_cards.content: The JU with R² shall initiate a force tell alert on a reference point, line, or area by setting the FT IND in the J3.0 Reference Point message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the primary objective of the actor (JU) to establish an alert status for specific geographic entities.

evidence_cards.content: A C2 JU or a JU capable of generating and maintaining track numbers may report an AOP based either on organic data, exchange of LOBs, analysis of EW fix data, or a combination of the above.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the high-level objective for the Primary Actor (C2 JU) to report an Area of Probability (AOP), which is a geometric area definition.
